caption:
This one fraction typo breaks Desmos.

Type 2/3x and Desmos reads it as 2/(3x). Type (2/3)x, or press the right arrow before the x.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Type 2/3x in Desmos and the x lands in the denominator. Use parentheses.

youtube.title: The Desmos Fraction Typo That Ruins SAT Systems
youtube.description: Put fraction coefficients in parentheses before graphing a system in Desmos. SAT-style practice question (original).
